description: Quantisation profile of the evaluator (04 section 4, task phase1.9_compositor-quantisation-profile): the registered profiles evaluated on the Tier 0 quantisation experiment and on the one-layer partial-coverage stack of blend-inputs. Residuals are |delta| in export units (16-bit PNG codes, OpenEXR float32 values) pooled over the texture sets, against both recordings (r1 same session, r2 after save and reopen).

entries.subject: Evaluator profile painter-12.1-isolated-half-alpha: the isolated root with the sRGB8 coverage written through binary16 and plain 32-bit float uniform colours
entries.formula: The isolated root of painter-12.1-isolated-linear (entry quantisation-isolated-root) with two write rules changed: the coverage plane of an sRGB8 intermediate is written as the 8-bit UNORM code of its binary16 value (round to nearest even), WriteUnorm(binary16(a), 8), and a uniform colour on a 32-bit float channel is the float32 of the value (the earlier profiles read it back as 1 + (v - 1) over the white base).

entries.notes: Selected: profile painter-12.1-isolated-half-alpha (src/evaluator/profile.h, decision 044), stamped into new projects; painter-12.1-isolated-linear and painter-12.1-layerq-linear stay registered for projects stamped with them. The binary16 coverage rule is measured on group-masks s2-s3 (masks-levels.json): a group coverage half-way between two 8-bit codes is stored up or down as its binary16 value lies, and only that rule makes their sRGB8 maps exact. The partial coverages of this experiment (1/3, 5/9, 19/27, 1/2) store the same codes under both rules, so every UNORM, sRGB8 and 16-bit float map here is exact against r1 as before. The plain 32-bit float operand is measured on group-masks row 0 and makes one more value of this experiment exact (s0 RGB32F G). The 32-bit float maps are still not exact: 3 of the 12 RGB32F values and 2 of the 4 L32F values lie 2^-25 or 2^-24 from r1; the float32 operation order of Painter's source-over onto a partly covered backdrop is not identified (parity/reports/phase1/compositor-float32-residual.md; a divergence, never counted as a pass, decision 032). r2 is covered by EXC-001 and EXC-002 as for the earlier profile.

entries.subject: Evaluator profile painter-12.1-isolated-linear: isolated root stack, per-layer storage in the channel format, one composite over the base at read-out, sRGB8 on linear values
entries.formula: Root stack isolated (a group without its own blend): the root layers composite bottom-up from a transparent start, straight colour C and coverage a, with the fitted kernels of blend-modes.json and W3C Compositing §5.1 (a transparent backdrop passes the source through, a partly covered one uses the general source-over formula in float32 with a correctly rounded reciprocal); after every layer C and a are stored in the channel format (UNORM n bits: truncate to n + 4 fractional bits, nearest, ties down; sRGB8: the recording GPU's float-to-sRGB8 conversion, blending on its linear decode; 16-bit float toward zero; 32-bit float as it is). At read-out the result is composited over the channel base once, v = base + (C - base) * a in float32 (one subtraction, one multiplication, one addition), and stored with the same write rule; an empty stack is the base. A grey channel takes the mean of the colour's three components. With a = 1 this is the 1 + (v - 1) read-out of blend-modes.json; with a < 1 the stored coverage below 1/2 (32767/65535 on 16 bits) sends every exact tie of a 0.5-opacity layer over the base up, as Painter does.

entries.notes: Superseded by painter-12.1-isolated-half-alpha (entry quantisation-isolated-half-alpha); still registered and evaluated as it was. Against the same-session recording r1 the isolated model reproduces every UNORM, sRGB8 and 16-bit float map of the experiment and every map of the blend-inputs s2 stack exactly (sRGB8 blended on linear values). The 32-bit float maps of the experiment are not exact: 4 of the 12 RGB32F values and 2 of the 4 L32F values lie 2^-25 or 2^-24 from r1 (the float32 operation order of Painter's source-over is not identified; r1 and r2 themselves differ on 9 of these 16 values). The after-reopen recording r2 differs from r1 itself on 16 of the experiment's 36 maps and on the sRGB8 and RGB8 maps of blend-inputs s2 (parity/reports/phase0/tier0-stability.md): both goldens are unstable, so under decision 032 r1 is their exact target and the register entries EXC-001 and EXC-002 (parity/exceptions.json) bound their r2 comparisons by the r2 residuals below; the 32-bit float residual against r1 stays a divergence (phase1.10_compositor-float32-residual). Run: parity/reports/phase1/compositor-quantisation-profile.md.

entries.subject: Evaluator profile painter-12.1-layerq-linear (provisional, superseded): per-layer quantisation over the base
entries.formula: Root layers blended onto an accumulator that starts at the channel base, v = acc (1 - alpha) + r alpha in float32, stored in the channel format after every layer with the same write rules; 32-bit float channels re-composited over the base once at read-out (1 + (v - 1)). The provisional profile of evaluator-profile.json.
